name: banner
description: Full-bleed horizontal banner: a wide background image (colored panel/diagonal baked into the image) with headline, text and an optional CTA (button or whole-banner arrow link).

cta.description: Button style 'arrow' turns the whole banner into the link.

image.description: 1920x480; the colored text panel is part of the image. Set the alt text in the asset's meta (translatable).

text_color.description: Pick 'inverse' (white) when the image panel behind the text is dark.

spacing_top.description: Background-matched vertical space top the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

spacing_bottom.description: Background-matched vertical space bottom the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

view.name: Banner
view.notes: Height 360px at 1440 (image cover, center). Text column ~560px at 30px left inset (content_position=left) or starting at ~850px (right, fischertechnik#6 'Made in Germany'), vertically centered. h2 42/52 600, body 18/28 300, mt 24. CTA: button primary mt 24, or arrow (24px) mt 30 with a stretched link covering the banner. Fallback bg when no image: #dbe2e6-ish via var(--color-panel). Image-only banner (no headline/body/cta) renders just the 1440x360 image (ft-pdp#3). Right-positioned inverse text over a dark image (ft-pdp#6): h2 48/58 600 right-aligned, body right-aligned 18/28 300.

styling_cues.panel: image-baked colored panel with diagonal edge (dark #2c292a / light #eef3f5 / red #d83d3d / blue #0169b3)
